coverageNote: Bounded city extracts, not exhaustive city inventories. Coordinates and seating tags are community mapped. Missing access and capacity are unverified. Quietness, current crowds and seclusion have not been measured. Way/relation centers are approximate.
processingNote: Seats only; exact OSM identities and coordinates retained. Explicit non-public access, conditional access and mapped indoor seats excluded. Tags restricted to seating/access facts; no mapper identifiers, contact details, photos or social-media content. No quiet scores, seat capacities or coordinates invented.
